li.name: article_remuneration

li.name: article_termination
li.p:
Either party may terminate this contract by giving written notice to the other party, in accordance with the notice periods and conditions provided by the applicable law. The contract may be terminated without notice in case of serious misconduct.
Unless renewed, this contract ends automatically at the end of its term.
